description: Map Studio component properties. The list is closed: later versions add properties here and in docs/.

startingArea.description: Where this component opens the map (epic 3 entry 6, docs/contract.md): a centre and zoom, or bounds. When all four bounds are numbers with west < east and south < north, the map fits them; otherwise it opens on the centre at the zoom. Two components on one page may open on different areas; both show the same map items. An invalid value opens on the whole world.

center.description: The centre of the starting view, WGS 84.

bounds.description: Bounds to fit instead of the centre and zoom, WGS 84; leave any value null to use the centre and zoom.

previewStyles.description: Draw the style preview panel over the map (epic 3 entry 1, docs/styles.md): every kind's style rule and area tints, each case in its preset, and the preset and tint palettes. The kind setup screen's preview, shown here for review; off by default.

editMode.description: Open the component in Edit mode (epic 3 entry 14, docs/contract.md). Today Edit mode holds the spike's Draw a line tool alone, which View mode never shows; epic-editing builds the studio behind it. The dev project's /edit page sets it; off by default.
